title: toolgraph policy bundle
description: Portable advisory policy decisions for one agent and profile. Consumers enforce the decisions; Toolgraph does not proxy calls.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with a UTC offset. Producer obligation; consumers MAY ignore it.

tools.description: One decision per exposed tool. tool_key values are unique across this array: the producer fails compilation rather than emit a duplicate, and a bundle containing one is invalid — consumers MUST NOT choose between conflicting rows and SHOULD reject the whole bundle. uniqueItems only backstops exact duplicate rows; the tool_key contract is stricter.

graphState.description: Collision-safe cache identity. Closed by design (additionalProperties: false): adding any field here is a schema_version-bump event, never an additive change.

generation.description: Graph mutation counter. Producers emit a JSON integer literal (7, never 7.0); strict consumers MAY reject an integral-float encoding even though JSON Schema treats it as an integer.

reason.description: Producers MUST emit a reason on every rejected decision and never emit one on an eligible decision. Consumers MAY treat an unrecognized reason as a generic rejection rather than fail — the rejection still stands — and MAY drop or normalize a reason found on an eligible decision.

risk_score.description: Required of producers; null when unranked. Advisory: consumers MAY ignore it and MAY normalize an absent value to null.

paths.description: Optional redacted evidence, emitted only for deny-path rejections. Advisory: consumers MAY ignore this field.
